visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person with a beige backpack and purple sweater pushes open a white framed glass door decorated with a small golden bell. (2) A woman in a teal t-shirt with the word "SUMMER" greets the camera with a cheerful expression inside a modern, brightly lit restaurant. (3) The woman holds up a massive, oversized cocktail glass overflowing with seafood on ice, including a lobster and several shrimps, smiling toward the lens. (4) Close-up shots show a whole lobster tail being cooked in a white creamy broth, followed by shots of a three-spotted crab and large shrimps being handled with tongs. (5) Various spoons scoop up abalone, scallops, and small octopus from a steaming hotpot filled with milky white soup. (6) The video showcases different hotpot bases, including a thick green curry-like soup and a spicy red broth with oily droplets. (7) A gold-toned three-tier stand is presented, containing plates of sliced pink pork meat and various fresh vegetables like cabbage. (8) Slices of pork are dipped into the bubbling spicy broth, and side dishes like noodles and rice are shown in close-up. (9) The interior of the restaurant is shown with large pink Lotso plush bears seated on white chairs, some placed behind solo diners for companionship. (10) The camera pans across the counter seating area with hanging globe lights before showing the exterior storefront with the restaurant name sign.
